pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free: $0. Pro: $17 per month billed annually ($200 up front), or $20 billed monthly. Max: from $100 per month, with a choice of 5x or 20x Pro's usage. Team… Standard seats are $20 per seat per month billed annually ($25 monthly)"

sources.title: How do I view and sign your Data Processing Addendum (DPA)?

gdpr_dpa.evidence: Web search summary: "Anthropic's DPA with Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) is automatically incorporated into the Commercial Terms of Service ... This applies to commercial products including Claude for Work and Claude API."
gdpr_dpa.note: Part of the Commercial Terms (Claude for Work and the API), with Anthropic as processor. Consumer plans (Free, Pro, Max) fall under the Consumer Terms.

sources.title: Opt-out required: Anthropic will use user data for training in future
Anthropic to use Claude conversations for AI training unless users opt out by September 28

trains_on_user_data.evidence: Web search summary: "On consumer plans (claude.ai Free/Pro/Max) by default since Aug 28, 2025 unless you opt out, chats are used for training. The default setting in privacy controls is on, requiring manual adjustment to opt out."
trains_on_user_data.note: Free, Pro and Max (incl. Claude Code on those accounts); new users choose at sign-up and can change it any time. The change does not apply to services under the Commercial Terms (Claude for Work, Education, Government, API).

plans.quota: 5× Pro usage; a 20× tier costs more

nl.tagline: AI-assistent van Anthropic, sterk in schrijven, analyse en code
nl.description: Claude is de AI-assistent van Anthropic. Hij is sterk in lange teksten, genuanceerd schrijven, documenten en data analyseren en programmeren, en werkt met projecten, bestanden en koppelingen. Er is een gratis versie; Pro en Max verhogen het gebruik.
limitations: Gebruikslimieten per tijdvenster, ook op betaalde plannen

en.tagline: Anthropic's AI assistant, strong at writing, analysis and code
en.description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant. It excels at long texts, nuanced writing, analysing documents and data, and programming, and works with projects, files and integrations. There is a free version; Pro and Max raise usage.
limitations: Usage limits per time window, also on paid plans
